intent.proves: No page URL name contains a character the documentation lists as illegal.
intent.scope: non-deleted pages with a Use in URL value; complete enumeration

bindings.reason: Tool is scoped to one area or page; a handler must enumerate every area/page and aggregate, which mcp-count does not do.

bindings.query: SELECT TOP 25 CAST(PageId AS nvarchar(20)) + N' ' + PageUrlName FROM Page WHERE PageDeleted = 0 AND ISNULL(PageUrlName, N'') <> N'' AND (PageUrlName LIKE N'%[+?#%:|<>*]%' OR CHARINDEX(NCHAR(59), PageUrlName) > 0 OR PageUrlName LIKE N'%  %')
